issues.display_title: Issue #1409: Preview: 360° Viewer Renders Panoramas Wavey / Distorted
issues.main_description_html:
Feedback (from @albug)

"Basically the viewer displays the images wavey."

When previewing a 360° equirectangular panorama in the interactive viewer, the rendered image appears wavey / distorted (visible warping across the scene, e.g. door frames and straight edges look rippled). See attached screenshot — the wavey distortion is marked in the room preview.

Context / Reference

Per docs/analyze-new.md §3 (Feature Inventory), the File Manager & Preview module provides the 360° interactive viewer built on Three.js / React Three Fiber. This issue affects that viewer's rendering fidelity.

This sits in the core daily-driver path: a distorted preview undermines trust in the edit→publish workflow (analyze-new.md §4 funnel: Import → First Edit/Preview → Publish). Preview rendering quality is part of the "reliability & trust" theme in analyze-new.md §7.

Expected

The 360° viewer renders the panorama smoothly with straight lines staying straight (no wavey/rippled distortion), matching the source equirectangular image.

Actual

The viewer displays the image with visible wavey distortion / warping.

Investigation starting points

  • 360° sphere mesh / geometry segment count in the Three.js viewer (low segment count on the sphere can cause visible waviness on straight edges).
  • Texture mapping / equirectangular projection sampling in the viewer shader.
  • Texture resolution downscaling or mipmapping settings (sharpConfig / thumbnail vs full-res texture).
  • Device pixel ratio / canvas sizing in React Three Fiber.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Straight architectural lines in a normal equirectangular panorama render straight in the viewer (no rippling).
  • No regression in viewer rotation/zoom performance.
  • Verified across at least the sample shown plus one high-res panorama.

Testing Scenario (for Tester)

Pre-conditions: App build with the fix installed · at least one tester machine (note GPU/CPU/RAM and OS) · sample images ready (see below). Record the source image resolution of each sample.

Test data to prepare:

  • A normal equirectangular 360° JPG with clear straight lines (door frames, walls, ceiling edges) — the main case from the screenshot.
  • A high-resolution equirectangular JPG (e.g. ≥ 8K / ≥ 20MB) — to check fidelity at large texture sizes.
  • A low-resolution / heavily compressed panorama — to confirm waviness is not just source quality.
  • A non-panorama / non-equirectangular image — negative check.

TC1 — Wavey Distortion Fixed (primary)

  1. Open the app, navigate to the folder, select the normal panorama, open Preview (360° viewer).
  2. Inspect straight edges (door frames, wall/ceiling lines) while stationary.
  3. Expected: Straight lines render straight — no wavey / rippled distortion. Matches the source equirectangular image.

TC2 — Rotation & Zoom Fidelity

  1. In the viewer, rotate (drag) and zoom in/out across the full panorama.
  2. Expected: No waviness appears or worsens while rotating/zooming; lines stay straight at all zoom levels; motion stays smooth (no stutter/regression).

TC3 — High-Resolution Panorama

  1. Open the high-res (≥ 8K) panorama in the viewer.
  2. Expected: No wavey distortion; full detail renders correctly; no crash, blank canvas, or excessive load time.

TC4 — Resolution Sensitivity (regression)

  1. Open the low-res / compressed panorama.
  2. Expected: Any softness is consistent with the source quality only — not the wavey/rippled artifact this issue describes.

TC5 — Cross-Image Consistency

  1. Switch between several panoramas in sequence within the viewer.
  2. Expected: Each renders without waviness; switching images does not reintroduce the distortion or leave artifacts from the previous image.

TC6 — Environment Check

  1. If feasible, repeat TC1 on a second machine with different GPU and OS.
  2. Expected: Rendering is correct (no waviness) regardless of GPU/OS; note any hardware where it still reproduces.

Reference

docs/analyze-new.md §3 (Preview module), §4 (funnel), §7 (reliability & trust).

RESULT

I have resolved the issue. See this file for more details.
